note: Term 4 2026: 10 weeks x 2 sessions = 20 stones in 5 lands. Each stone is one session: warm-up (from the other maths topic), maths (learn, training, game, boss), English (read, words, how do you know), thinking game. The child's map shows stone numbers only; a grown-up can change what any stone holds in Grown-ups > Plan (saved per device as st.plan). Unit ids are app.id values in data/units. minutes are a guide for the grown-up, never shown to the child as a timer.
